## Change / 变更

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. 说明具体问题与改动后的行为。

## Verification / 验证

List commands actually run, results, and hardware observations if applicable.
列出实际运行的命令、结果及相关硬件观察。

- [ ] RF parameters, wiring and timing are unchanged, or changes have separate evidence.
      射频参数、接线及时序未改变，或已提供独立证据。
- [ ] Generated headers and relevant builds/checks are current.
      生成头文件及相关构建、检查已更新。
- [ ] English/Chinese docs and meaningful comments agree.
      中英文文档及有意义的注释一致。
- [ ] No passwords, tokens, personal identifiers or unauthorized captures are included.
      未包含密码、凭证、个人标识或无权分享的采样。

## Limits / 局限

State unrun tests and known risks; do not equate CI with hardware validation.
注明未执行测试及已知风险，不以 CI 代替硬件验证。
